69f2d088179e524ac52d63b0 description: A man that does not struggle, is no man at all. Prove to the Eye that you are a Struggler.
69f2d3ae179e524ac52d63b3: Stash Intelligence in the cultist room in the Shoreline resort
6a04b54fee995153b15a3e70 description:
We have seen you from afar, and now seen you in the flesh.

You will help us, and we will help you, yes?
6a04b54fee995153b15a3e70 successMessageT: Oh? Do not think that such a simple task will grant you the ecstasy you seek.
6a04b6d9ee995153b15a3e7b description:
You see... the Eye is always looking for new Strugglers to complete his will. Complete the tasks laid bare and maybe the Eye will give you the aid you seek. 

In the forests of Tarkov there is a meeting place for candidates like yourself. It lies off the path used by the machines of 'man'. A gateway into a yard of lumber.
6a04b6d9ee995153b15a3e7b successMessageT: Hmmm. It seems you may be a struggler after all. Fine, take this gift as a welcoming present.
6a07ab1f8ff25d06e48d31e3 description: Hello Struggler, The eye has sent you a gift. Befitting one of us I would say. It has been left at where you made your last sacrifice.
6a07ab1f8ff25d06e48d31e3 successMessageT: This holds the info on the gateway to paradise.
6a07ab808ff25d06e48d31e8 description:
There was once a great engineer, who designed a maze to hold an etherial being a bay. The Eye's greatest supporters are the ones that hold the key.

Find the keyholder and TAKE HIS PLACE.
6a07ac2b8ff25d06e48d31ef: Find Labrys access keycard in raid
6afeb323c44ae2aae78f9530 description: [PH] Struggler. The Eye has watched you, and the Eye is pleased. But the family only opens its doors at night. Bring twenty of the lost ones to the dark, between ten and six. Then we will talk.
6afeb323c44ae2aae78f9530 successMessageT: [PH] Twenty souls in the night. The family welcomes you. Take this blade, when you are ready for it.
6afeb3258349e093f30637a2 description: [PH] The Eye hungers for light, and light is computation. Leave two graphics cards in the marked room of the dormitory on Customs. Do not ask what they will run.
6afeb3258349e093f30637a2 successMessageT: [PH] The offering hums. Take these, the Eye has no need of power supplies.
6afeb3258349e093f30637a4: Leave 2 graphics cards in the marked room of the Customs dorms
6afeb326a715d788320efccd description: [PH] There is one on the island at Lighthouse who keeps a light of his own. He and the Eye are... acquainted. Go and see him. Do not stay long.
6afeb326a715d788320efccd successMessageT: [PH] He saw you. Good. Take this card. The Eye returns what it borrows.
6afeb326a715d788320efccf: Visit the Lightkeeper's island on Lighthouse
6afeb327486ca79d3ba87bd3 description: [PH] Gold that is not gold. Coins that are not coins. Leave one Bitcoin in the circle near the bunker in Woods. The Eye collects curiosities.
6afeb327486ca79d3ba87bd3 successMessageT: [PH] Accepted. Here is the transmitter you will need for what comes. Guard it.
6afeb327486ca79d3ba87bd5: Leave a Physical Bitcoin in the circle by the Woods bunker
6afeb3283c1a437f7c92d6ef description: [PH] The marked room on Lighthouse. Leave a yellow key to the laboratory and a case of injectors there. The family needs both doors and medicine.
6afeb3283c1a437f7c92d6ef successMessageT: [PH] The room is furnished. You are nearly one of us.
6afeb3283c1a437f7c92d6f1: Leave a yellow Labs keycard in the marked room on Lighthouse
6afeb3283c1a437f7c92d6f2: Leave an Injector case in the marked room on Lighthouse
6afeb329a6457b3b32f01cc1 description: [PH] The last rite. Use the blade of the family on one of the lost. Up close. The Eye wants to see it in their eyes.
6afeb329a6457b3b32f01cc1 successMessageT: [PH] Welcome home, Struggler. The family provides. Take what you need.
